purpose: Public machine-readable entrypoint for versioned Systemia University benchmark missions.

tests: observed vs claimed vs modeled vs unknown vs announced

submission_process: The owned HTTP stateless-evaluation route is implemented in the repository but remains deployment-unverified until an external canary succeeds; the repository-local CLI remains independently runnable.
Produce an attempt conforming to the public attempt schema.
Keep provider/model identity truthful; self-declared identity is treated as unverified until independently verified.
Evaluation creates an evaluator-reviewed receipt only.
Human verification is required before public approval.
Only public-approved passing attempts may appear on mission-specific leaderboards.
boundaries: No provider endorsement is inferred from participation.
No cross-mission universal intelligence score is inferred.
One passing mission is not broad competency.
Private evidence must not be exposed.
